notes.title: VRider SBK releases on June 27th!
notes.content:
Get ready to rev your engines, it is almost time! 🏍️


Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that VRider SBK is arriving on Steam on June 27th! Just one more week to wait!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591055/f02d36480b01346c622e97a1b3ddd0b71f4854da.png"]
But something tells us it will fly by as fast as your bike speeding through tracks in a few days. Get ready to immerse yourself in this unique experience soon! It's time to climb up the leaderboards.

Make sure to join our Discord and follow our socials to keep yourself updated at all times.

notes.title: VRider SBK is coming soon!
notes.content:
🏍️Experience the thrill of racing, like never before. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591055/49f694cae0dc5325b9a41ddc62d723c7d04cd6b1.png"]

Hey everyone!


We are absolutely thrilled for you to meet VRider SBK soon! We are working hard to give you the best experience, hopefully, you will enjoy the ride!


As you might know, VRider SBK is already available on Meta Quest - so you might ask what the difference will be, and whether we have any enhancements or not. The answer is, we do!


Visual improvements (trees, grass, circuits, bikes, buildings, terrain, skids, etc.) and enhanced graphics on Steam.

Race against Meta Quest players via crossplay!

Animated crowd & flags.

More AI opponents (22) in single-player modes.

Customizable graphic options.

and more!



Thank you for all the support! Make sure to join our Discord and follow our socials to keep yourself updated at all times.



Twitter Discord Instagram TikTok
